19: // `entire graph verify` — an ADJUDICATED verdict, not test output
20: // ==============================================================
21: //
22: // MEASURED BASIS. Post-last-edit confirmation is 5.8 messages per session, the single largest asymmetric
23: // pot at 5.0 messages. Every prior attempt to shrink it FREED budget the agent immediately re-spent on
24: // more verification: transfer efficiency 0.2-0.35, meaning two thirds of every saving went straight back
25: // into running tests again. A cheaper way to run tests therefore cannot work. The only thing that closes
26: // the phase is a verdict with nothing left to re-spend on — which requires three properties that
27: // ordinary test output does not have:
28: //
29: //   - A DELTA, not a state. "3 tests fail" invites a run to find out whether they failed before. The
30: //     pre-edit baseline turns that into "these 3 failed before your edit too", which is not actionable
31: //     and is explicitly labelled so.
32: //   - A VERDICT, not evidence. Output is something to interpret, and interpreting invites re-running.
33: //     The verb states the conclusion and the conclusion's own completeness.
34: //   - NO RAW OUTPUT, EVER. Forwarding even an excerpt reopens the loop this verb exists to close, so
35: //     nothing the runner printed reaches the caller. Ids are forwarded; text is not.
36: //
37: // FAIRNESS. This verb is tool CAPABILITY — it runs a command the caller supplies and adjudicates the
38: // result. It prints no instruction the control arm's harness-side stub cannot also print: the
39: // "verification is complete" sentence is a statement about the DATA (a zero-regression, ≥1-fix delta is
40: // by definition complete), not advice about how to behave. Nothing here tells the reader what to do.

47: 	// the information, so the remainder is summarised rather than dropped silently.

51: 	// before it runs a test, an interpreted one does not.
52: 	verifyCompiledTimeout    = 900 * time.Second
53: 	verifyInterpretedTimeout = 300 * time.Second

208: // runVerifyShell executes one command in the repository. It returns the exit code separately from the

124: 		}

128: 	if args[0] == "resolve" {

133: 		if err != nil {

135: 		}
136: 		for _, binding := range set.Bindings {
137: 			if binding.ID == flags.id {

142: 	}

146: func runGPSContext(ctx context.Context, opts Options, args []string) error {
147: 	_, flags, err := gpsFlags(args)
148: 	if err != nil {
149: 		return err
150: 	}
151: 	if flags.query == "" {
152: 		return errors.New("context requires --query")
153: 	}
154: 	if flags.maxBytes < minimumGPSContextBytes {
155: 		return fmt.Errorf("context --max-context-bytes must be at least %d", minimumGPSContextBytes)
156: 	}
157: 	repo, err := resolveRepo(ctx, opts.Env, flags.repo)
158: 	if err != nil {
159: 		return err
160: 	}
161: 	set, err := gpsIntent(ctx, repo, flags.head)
162: 	if err != nil {
163: 		return err
164: 	}
165: 	requirements := matchingRequirements(set, flags.query)
166: 	response := map[string]any{"schema_version": gpsSchemaVersion, "request": flags.query, "intent_digest": set.Digest, "repository_view": gpsRepositoryView(ctx, repo, flags.head), "status": "complete", "requirements": requirements, "symbols": []any{}, "code": []any{}, "dependencies": []any{}, "tests": []any{}, "inferred_tests": []any{}, "gaps": []string{}, "budget": map[string]any{"maximum_bytes": flags.maxBytes, "rendered_bytes": 0, "omitted": []string{}}}
167: 	if len(set.Specs) == 0 {
168: 		response["status"] = "complete_with_gaps"
169: 		response["gaps"] = []string{"NO_SPECS"}
170: 	}
171: 	snapshot, err := gpsSnapshot(ctx, opts, repo, flags.head)
172: 	if err != nil {
173: 		return err
174: 	}
175: 	search, err := sem.SearchRepository(ctx, repo, opts.Version, flags.query, sem.SearchOptions{Worktree: !flags.head, Profile: sem.ProfileFull, TopK: 5, MaxContextBytes: flags.maxBytes, DisableCache: true})
176: 	if err != nil {
177: 		return err
178: 	}
179: 	code := make([]any, 0, len(search.Results))
180: 	for _, result := range search.Results {
181: 		// A bounded snippet leaves quota for inferred tests instead of letting one
182: 		// search result consume the entire source-evidence section.
183: 		code = append(code, map[string]any{"reason": "ranked_code_search", "rank": result.Rank, "score": result.Score, "citation": fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", result.FilePath, result.FocusLine), "symbol_id": result.SymbolID, "snippet": trimUTF8(result.Snippet, 160), "snippet_start_line": result.SnippetStartLine, "snippet_end_line": result.SnippetEndLine})
184: 	}
185: 	response["code"] = code
186: 	selected := make(map[string]bool, len(requirements))
187: 	for _, requirement := range requirements {
188: 		selected[requirement["id"]] = true
189: 	}
190: 	bindings := make(map[string]intent.Binding, len(set.Bindings))
191: 	for _, binding := range set.Bindings {
192: 		bindings[binding.ID] = binding
193: 	}
194: 	var symbols []any
195: 	var dependencies []any
196: 	var tests []any
197: 	var inferredTests []any
198: 	gaps := response["gaps"].([]string)
199: 	for _, spec := range set.Specs {
200: 		for _, anchor := range spec.Anchors {
201: 			if !selected[anchor.Requirement] {
202: 				continue
203: 			}
204: 			binding, ok := bindings[anchor.ID]
205: 			if !ok {
206: 				gaps = append(gaps, "UNBOUND_ANCHOR:"+anchor.ID)
207: 				continue
208: 			}
209: 			state := resolveBinding(binding, snapshot)
210: 			if state["state"] != "VALID" {
211: 				gaps = append(gaps, state["state"].(string)+":"+anchor.ID)
212: 				continue
213: 			}
214: 			symbol := state["symbol"].(sem.SymbolRecord)
215: 			symbols = append(symbols, map[string]any{"anchor": anchor.ID, "requirement": anchor.Requirement, "reason": "approved_anchor", "citation": fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", symbol.FilePath, symbol.StartLine), "symbol": symbol})
216: 			for _, relation := range snapshot.Relations {
217: 				if relation.FromID == symbol.ID {
218: 					dependencies = append(dependencies, map[string]any{"reason": "anchor_callee", "type": relation.Type, "symbol_id": relation.ToID})
219: 				}
220: 				if relation.ToID == symbol.ID {
221: 					dependencies = append(dependencies, map[string]any{"reason": "anchor_caller", "type": relation.Type, "symbol_id": relation.FromID})
222: 				}
223: 			}
224: 		}
225: 		for _, test := range spec.Tests {
226: 			if !acceptanceMatchesRequirement(spec, test.Acceptance, selected) {
227: 				continue
228: 			}
229: 			matches := matchingSymbols(snapshot.Symbols, test.Selector.Name, "")
230: 			if len(matches) == 1 {
231: 				tests = append(tests, map[string]any{"id": test.ID, "acceptance": test.Acceptance, "reason": "declared_mapping", "symbol": matches[0]})
232: 			} else {
233: 				gaps = append(gaps, "DECLARED_TEST_UNRESOLVED:"+test.ID)
234: 			}
235: 		}
236: 	}
237: 	for _, symbol := range snapshot.Symbols {
238: 		if !strings.HasPrefix(symbol.Name, "Test") || !queryMatchesText(flags.query, symbol.Name) {
239: 			continue
240: 		}
241: 		inferredTests = append(inferredTests, map[string]any{"reason": "name_match_candidate", "fulfills_mapping": false, "citation": fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", symbol.FilePath, symbol.StartLine), "symbol_id": symbol.ID, "name": symbol.QualifiedName})
242: 	}
243: 	sort.Strings(gaps)
244: 	response["symbols"] = symbols
245: 	response["dependencies"] = dependencies
246: 	response["tests"] = tests
247: 	response["inferred_tests"] = inferredTests
248: 	response["gaps"] = gaps
249: 	if len(gaps) > 0 {
250: 		response["status"] = "complete_with_gaps"
251: 	}
252: 	fitGPSContextBudget(response, flags.maxBytes)
253: 	return gpsEncode(opts, flags.format, response)
254: }

256: func runGPSCheck(ctx context.Context, opts Options, args []string) error {
257: 	_, flags, err := gpsFlags(args)
258: 	if err != nil {
259: 		return err
260: 	}
261: 	if flags.base != "" && !flags.head {
262: 		return errors.New("check --base requires --head so code and intent use one committed view")
263: 	}
264: 	repo, err := resolveRepo(ctx, opts.Env, flags.repo)
265: 	if err != nil {
266: 		return err
267: 	}
268: 	set, err := gpsIntent(ctx, repo, flags.head)
269: 	if err != nil {
270: 		return err
271: 	}
272: 	if len(set.Specs) == 0 {
273: 		return gpsEncode(opts, flags.format, map[string]any{"schema_version": gpsSchemaVersion, "repository_view": gpsRepositoryView(ctx, repo, flags.head), "change_delta": "not_requested", "disposition": "NOT_CONFIGURED", "findings": []any{}})
274: 	}
275: 	snapshot, err := gpsSnapshot(ctx, opts, repo, flags.head)
276: 	if err != nil {
277: 		return err
278: 	}
279: 	findings := make([]map[string]any, 0)
280: 	if len(snapshot.Header.PartialFailures) != 0 || snapshot.Header.Stats.CompletenessLevel != "ok" {
281: 		findings = append(findings, map[string]any{"id": "GPS-COMPLETENESS-INCOMPLETE", "severity": "incomplete", "subject": "graph", "message": "selected graph has partial or incomplete analysis"})
282: 	}
283: 	if flags.base != "" {
284: 		baseRevision, err := gitutil.RevParse(ctx, repo, flags.base)
285: 		if err != nil {
286: 			return fmt.Errorf("resolve base revision: %w", err)
287: 		}
288: 		headRevision, err := gitutil.RevParse(ctx, repo, "HEAD")
289: 		if err != nil {
290: 			return fmt.Errorf("resolve current revision: %w", err)
291: 		}
292: 		baseSet, err := intent.LoadRevision(ctx, repo, baseRevision)
293: 		if err != nil {
294: 			return fmt.Errorf("load base intent: %w", err)
295: 		}
296: 		changed, err := gitutil.ChangedFiles(ctx, repo, baseRevision, headRevision, nil)
297: 		if err != nil {
298: 			return fmt.Errorf("compare base revision: %w", err)
299: 		}
300: 		if baseSet.Digest != set.Digest {
301: 			findings = append(findings, map[string]any{"id": "GPS-DELTA-INTENT", "severity": "warning", "subject": "intent", "message": "selected intent differs from base revision"})
302: 		}
303: 		currentTests := map[string]bool{}
304: 		for _, spec := range set.Specs {
305: 			for _, test := range spec.Tests {
306: 				currentTests[test.ID] = true
307: 			}
308: 		}
309: 		for _, spec := range baseSet.Specs {
310: 			for _, test := range spec.Tests {
311: 				if !currentTests[test.ID] {
312: 					findings = append(findings, map[string]any{"id": "GPS-DELTA-MAPPING-REMOVED", "severity": "warning", "subject": test.ID, "message": "declared test mapping was removed since base revision"})
313: 				}
314: 			}
315: 		}
316: 		intentChanged, codeChanged := false, false
317: 		for _, file := range changed {
318: 			if strings.HasPrefix(file.Path, intent.Root+"/") || strings.HasPrefix(file.OldPath, intent.Root+"/") {
319: 				intentChanged = true
320: 			} else {
321: 				codeChanged = true
322: 			}
323: 			for _, binding := range set.Bindings {
324: 				if binding.Selector.File == file.Path || binding.Selector.File == file.OldPath {
325: 					findings = append(findings, map[string]any{"id": "GPS-DELTA-ANCHOR", "severity": "warning", "subject": binding.ID, "message": "anchored implementation changed since base revision"})
326: 				}
327: 			}
328: 			for _, spec := range set.Specs {
329: 				for _, test := range spec.Tests {
330: 					for _, symbol := range matchingSymbols(snapshot.Symbols, test.Selector.Name, "") {
331: 						if symbol.FilePath == file.Path || symbol.FilePath == file.OldPath {
332: 							findings = append(findings, map[string]any{"id": "GPS-DELTA-TEST", "severity": "warning", "subject": test.ID, "message": "declared test implementation changed since base revision"})
333: 						}
334: 					}
335: 				}
336: 			}
337: 		}
338: 		if intentChanged && !codeChanged {
339: 			findings = append(findings, map[string]any{"id": "GPS-DELTA-SPEC-ONLY", "severity": "warning", "subject": "intent", "message": "specification changed without implementation changes"})
340: 		}
341: 		if codeChanged && !intentChanged {
342: 			findings = append(findings, map[string]any{"id": "GPS-DELTA-CODE-ONLY", "severity": "warning", "subject": "code", "message": "implementation changed without specification changes"})
343: 		}
344: 	}
345: 	for _, spec := range set.Specs {
346: 		for _, anchor := range spec.Anchors {
347: 			found := false
348: 			for _, binding := range set.Bindings {
349: 				if binding.ID != anchor.ID {
350: 					continue
351: 				}
352: 				found = true
353: 				state := resolveBinding(binding, snapshot)
354: 				if state["state"] != "VALID" {
355: 					findings = append(findings, map[string]any{"id": "GPS-ANCHOR-" + state["state"].(string), "severity": "warning", "subject": anchor.ID, "message": state["state"]})
356: 				}
357: 			}
358: 			if !found {
359: 				findings = append(findings, map[string]any{"id": "GPS-ANCHOR-UNBOUND", "severity": "warning", "subject": anchor.ID, "message": "declared anchor has no reviewed binding"})
360: 			}
361: 		}
362: 		for _, acceptance := range spec.Acceptance {
363: 			mapped := false
364: 			for _, test := range spec.Tests {
365: 				if test.Acceptance == acceptance.ID {
366: 					mapped = true
367: 					matches := matchingSymbols(snapshot.Symbols, test.Selector.Name, "")
368: 					if len(matches) != 1 {
369: 						findings = append(findings, map[string]any{"id": "GPS-MAPPING-UNRESOLVED", "severity": "warning", "subject": test.ID, "message": "declared test selector does not resolve to exactly one symbol"})
370: 					}
371: 				}
372: 			}
373: 			if !mapped {
374: 				findings = append(findings, map[string]any{"id": "GPS-MAPPING-MISSING", "severity": "warning", "subject": acceptance.ID, "message": "acceptance criterion has no declared test"})
375: 			}
376: 		}
377: 	}
378: 	disposition := "PASS"
379: 	for _, finding := range findings {
380: 		if finding["severity"] == "incomplete" {
381: 			disposition = "INCOMPLETE"
382: 			break
383: 		}
384: 		if finding["severity"] == "error" {
385: 			disposition = "FAIL"
386: 			break
387: 		}
388: 		disposition = "REVIEW_REQUIRED"
389: 	}
390: 	changeDelta := "not_requested"
391: 	if flags.base != "" {
392: 		changeDelta = "compared"
393: 	}
394: 	response := map[string]any{"schema_version": gpsSchemaVersion, "intent_digest": set.Digest, "repository_view": gpsRepositoryView(ctx, repo, flags.head), "change_delta": changeDelta, "disposition": disposition, "findings": findings}
395: 	if flags.evidence != "" {
396: 		response["execution_evidence"] = gpsExecutionEvidence(flags.evidence, set)
397: 	}
398: 	return gpsEncode(opts, flags.format, response)
399: }

538: func gpsFlags(args []string) (string, gpsOptions, error) {
539: 	flags := gpsOptions{format: "json", maxBytes: 12000}
540: 	for i := 0; i < len(args); i++ {
541: 		value := func() (string, error) {
542: 			i++
543: 			if i >= len(args) {
544: 				return "", fmt.Errorf("%s requires a value", args[i-1])
545: 			}
546: 			return args[i], nil
547: 		}
548: 		switch args[i] {
549: 		case "--repo", "--format", "--id", "--symbol", "--file", "--query", "--base", "--evidence", "--max-context-bytes":
550: 			v, err := value()
551: 			if err != nil {
552: 				return "", flags, err
553: 			}
554: 			switch args[i-1] {
555: 			case "--repo":
556: 				flags.repo = v
557: 			case "--format":
558: 				flags.format = v
559: 			case "--id":
560: 				flags.id = v
561: 			case "--symbol":
562: 				flags.symbol = v
563: 			case "--file":
564: 				flags.file = v
565: 			case "--query":
566: 				flags.query = v
567: 			case "--base":
568: 				flags.base = v
569: 			case "--evidence":
570: 				flags.evidence = v
571: 			default:
572: 				if _, err := fmt.Sscan(v, &flags.maxBytes); err != nil || flags.maxBytes < 1 {
573: 					return "", flags, errors.New("--max-context-bytes requires a positive integer")
574: 				}
575: 			}
576: 		case "--head":
577: 			flags.head = true
578: 		case "--update":
579: 			flags.update = true
580: 		case "--json":
581: 			flags.format = "json"
582: 		default:
583: 			return "", flags, fmt.Errorf("unexpected argument %q", args[i])
584: 		}
585: 	}
586: 	if flags.format != "json" && flags.format != "text" {
587: 		return "", flags, errors.New("--format must be json or text")
588: 	}
589: 	return "", flags, nil
590: }
